en.title: Largest Set Where Each Bag Is the Square of the Previous One
en.description:
All bags have pairwise distinct rice counts. Choose at least two bags such that, after sorting in ascending order, the square of each item equals exactly the next item. Return the maximum number of bags that can be chosen, or −1 if there is no solution.

This site independently prepared the standard I/O and the solution; bounds supplemented where the source lacks them and corrections to examples are stated explicitly in the specification.
en.input: The first line contains n, and the second line contains n distinct integers. The original bounds 1≤n≤200000 and 2≤riceBags[i]≤10^6 are restored; the incorrect constraint spliced together by HTML cleanup must not be used.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 3; -1; 2. Verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Store all numbers in a set; starting from each number, square repeatedly and count the length of the chain that stays in the set.
